idea-plugin.name: MyBatis Log Helper
idea-plugin.description:
MyBatis Log Helper

Restore executable SQL from MyBatis Preparing and Parameters logs in the Run/Debug Console. This helps you quickly reproduce the exact SQL with all parameters filled in.

Key Features

  • Context menu actions in Run/Debug Console: Restore Executable SQL, Restore & Copy SQL
  • Auto-detects the nearest MyBatis log block around the caret
  • Parses parameters and replaces ? in order
  • Handles common types: null, numbers, strings (with quotes), dates, booleans
  • Warns when SQL placeholders and parameter count do not match
  • Beautify long SQL for easier reading

How to Use

  1. Open Run/Debug Console and locate MyBatis log output.
  2. Place the caret on any line inside the log block.
  3. Right-click and choose Restore Executable SQL (or Restore & Copy SQL).
  4. The restored SQL will be shown in a dialog with a Copy button.

Supported Log Formats

  • Preparing: or ==> Preparing: for SQL
  • Parameters: or ==> Parameters: for parameters

Example

Input log:

2026-02-04 10:00:01 [DEBUG] - ==>  Preparing: select * from t_user where name = ? and age > ?
2026-02-04 10:00:01 [DEBUG] - ==> Parameters: "ZhangSan"(String), 18(Integer)

Restored SQL:

select * from t_user where name = 'ZhangSan' and age > 18

Settings

Settings are available under Settings / Preferences > MyBatis Log Helper:

  • Boolean output style (TRUE/FALSE or 1/0)
  • DateTime format (default: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss)
  • Auto copy restored SQL
  • Append semicolon automatically
  • Beautify by default in result dialog
  • Copy keeps beautified format
  • Close dialog after copy

Tips

  • Place the caret anywhere inside the log block to restore SQL.
  • Use Beautify to format long SQL for readability.
  • Copy button always copies the current view (raw or beautified).

FAQ

  • Why do I see warnings? Usually the log block is incomplete or parameter count mismatches.
  • Can it work with multi-line SQL? Yes, the extractor collects consecutive SQL lines.
  • Does it support null values? Yes, null values are restored as NULL.

Notes

  • If only Preparing or only Parameters is found, a warning will be shown.
  • When counts mismatch, the dialog still shows the best-effort restoration.
